Tr(Theta_K Theta^L) = 16 if K = L and 0 otherwise, for all 65536 pairs: the 256 matrices Theta^K are a basis of the complex 16x16 matrices, and Theta_K is the dual basis

invariance: for the 28 generators (1/2) Gamma^A Gamma^B (A < B), (i) Sigma^dagger.Adj + Adj.Sigma = 0, so that psibar psi is invariant, and (ii) the commutator [Theta^K, Gamma^A Gamma^B] is zero or a multiple c_K of the single matrix Theta^K' of the same rank with K' = K with A, B exchanged in or out, and eps_K c_K + eps_K' c_K' = 0: each of the nine invariants I_r = sum_K (psibar Theta_K psi)(psibar Theta^K psi) is invariant. The group is Spin(7,1)

Fierz rearrangement. Every Theta^K either commutes or anticommutes with every Theta^L; the sum of these signs over the index sets K of rank r is the same for all L of rank s and equals 16 F_rs with the closed form F_rs = (1/16) sum_l (-1)^(rs - l) C(s, l) C(8 - s, r - l); the identity sum_(K of rank r) (Theta_K)_(ab) (Theta^K)_(cd) = sum_s F_rs sum_(L of rank s) (Theta_L)_(ad) (Theta^L)_(cb) holds for all 9 x 65536 combinations of r and of the spinor indices a, b, c, d (verified with the adjoint matrix multiplied in, that is for the matrices M_K); F^2 = 1, Tr F = 16/16, rank(1 + F) = 5 and rank(1 - F) = 4: F has the eigenvalue +1 five times and -1 four times

THEOREM (anticommuting fields). Write I_r = sum T^(r)_(abcd) psi_a^* psi_b psi_c^* psi_d. Two tensors give the same polynomial in Grassmann variables exactly if their parts antisymmetric in b and d agree, A_(abcd) = T_(abcd) - T_(adcb). The nine tensors T^(r) are linearly independent (rank 9), but their antisymmetric parts satisfy sum_s (delta_rs + F_rs) A^(s) = 0 for every r and span a space of dimension 4: the nine invariants obey (1 + F) I = 0, five independent linear relations, and four invariants are independent. In terms of I_0, I_1, I_7, I_8: I_2 = -3 I_0 - I_1 - I_7 - I_8, I_3 = -4 I_0 - I_7 + 4 I_8, I_4 = -5 I_0 - 5 I_8, I_5 = -4 I_0 - I_1 + 4 I_8, I_6 = -I_0 + I_1 + I_7 - 3 I_8 (each verified on all 65536 components).
